name: Brandon Moreno

tale_of_tape.source: data/derived/fighters.json (67 in height, 70 in reach, Orthodox); flyweight limit 125 lb (Noche UFC, Sep 2026)

photo_coverage: Good. 10 photos: two freely licensed Commons photos (CC BY-SA 4.0 frontal portrait, Feb 2021; CC BY 4.0 press-conference photo, Jul 2023), current studio headshot and full-body cutout (Sep 2026), an older cutout with the belt (Jan 2023), a right near-profile at the Noche UFC weigh-in (Sep 11, 2026, most recent), a frontal smiling media-day shot (Sep 2026), a high-resolution three-quarter (Sep 2024), a high-resolution right profile (Dec 2025) and one grappling photo. No clean left profile and no photo of his standing guard.

face.shape: Lean oval-to-rectangular face of medium width and medium-long length; flat, slightly hollow cheeks with visible smile folds.
face.jaw: Defined and moderately angular, medium width.
face.chin: Medium width, slightly squared, moderately projecting.
face.cheekbones: High and fairly broad, with hollows below them; they bunch up strongly when he smiles.
face.brow_ridge: Moderate; brows sit low over the eyes.
face.forehead: Medium-high and smooth, with a straight hairline very slightly recessed at the temples.

eyes.shape: Almond eyes, slightly narrow, with a moderately low upper-lid crease and a slight fold at the inner corners; crow's feet and fine under-eye lines; mild lower-lid bags

eyebrows.shape: Straight and low, tails angled slightly up and out; inner ends close

nose.tip: Rounded and slightly bulbous, nostrils medium-wide; in profile the tip points straight ahead to slightly up

face.mouth_lips: Medium-wide mouth; thin-to-medium upper lip, fuller lower lip; corners slightly down at rest; a wide, toothy smile that lifts the cheeks.

ears.cauliflower_ear: Yes, mild to moderate on both ears: the right ear's helix and concha are lumpy and thickened, and the left ear's inner folds are swollen (ESPN headshot zoom, Sep 2026).
ears.note: Stand out from the head; very visible with the faded sides.

face.notable_marks_scars: Fine lines at the outer eyes and across the forehead; a small dark mark on the right ear; no large scars visible.

hair.style: Short textured cut: about 4-6 cm on top, worn up and slightly forward with piecey texture; low-to-mid skin fade on the sides and back.
hair.colour_note: Raw top sample in the ESPN headshot is #110b0a; very dark brown, near black.
hair.hairline: Straight, very slightly recessed at the temples

facial_hair.detail: Clean-shaven in Sep 2026 with a faint dark stubble shadow on the upper lip and chin. In 2021 he wore a thin moustache and chin stubble (Commons photo).

skin.tone_hex_method: plain RGB mean of the face samples marked in_average (well-lit cheeks, no specular highlight, no strong colour cast); each sample is the median of the 25th-65th luma-percentile pixels of its patch
skin.tone_hex_recommended_method: 60% face average + 40% torso (ESPN studio cutout, same lighting setup used for all four fighters in this batch), so one whole-body tint does not come out flash-pale
skin.undertone: Warm light-medium, light olive/tan; the lightest of this group.
skin.freckles_marks: Fine expression lines around the eyes; dark hair on the legs and forearms; little chest hair.
skin.note: Excluded: the specular forehead, the Feb 2021 Commons portrait (cool, one-sided window light: #e7c6bb vs #ba8a78 on the two cheeks), the shadowed media-day cheek and the over-exposed Sep 2024 daylight shot. His torso (#dda17a) is as light as his face, unlike Van's.

body.build: Lean, average-framed flyweight: 170 cm, 57 kg (125 lb).
body.body_fat_note: Lean but not shredded: soft-edged abs, little visible vascularity compared with Taira or Van.
body.arms: Long and lean; reach 178 cm (8 cm more than his height)
body.legs_calves: Long, lean legs; slim calves; hairy shins
body.posture: Relaxed and upright; slight forward head carriage
body.notable: Longer legs than Van; less upper-body mass.

tattoos.description: Colour Aztec-style feathered serpent head (Quetzalcoatl), snout pointing toward the centre of his chest, with red, green, yellow and white feathers, a red open mouth and a gold eye frame.
Black tribal flames/spikes curving over the top of the right shoulder onto the collarbone and upper chest.

tattoos.where: right arm (upper arm and forearm), patchwork half-sleeves
tattoos.description: Black-and-grey: on the outer upper arm a tall arch monument with clouds and a sign (a word on the sign reads like 'TIJUANA' in the cutout); on the outer forearm a standing Aztec warrior with a feathered headdress; vertical script 'Jiu Jitsu' on the inner forearm. Skin shows between the pieces at the elbow.
Black outline of a rapier/sword lying along the outer left forearm; small vertical script near the left wrist on the inner side; a tiny 'S'-shaped mark on the inner left arm near the elbow.
Vertical line of script down the left side (seen in the UFC 323 grappling photo); not legible.

tattoos_note: The right arm carries most of the black-and-grey work; the colour piece is on the LEFT chest. Sides are his own (when he faces the camera, the serpent is image-right and the tribal shoulder image-left). Back not clearly seen.

kit.fight_shorts: Noche UFC (Sep 2026, red corner): red Venum shorts with an Aztec feathered-serpent print in red, green, white and gold, a black waistband with a maroon UFC tab and MORENO lettering in green. Green Venum shorts in the 2023 cutout.
kit.presser: T-shirts (white or black), Apple-style watch, red-white-green bead bracelet

stance_and_guard.observed: No standing-guard photo was found (face-offs, pressers and one grappling photo only).
stance_and_guard.style: Jab-led boxer at range who mixes in takedowns and back takes (data/scouting/brandon-moreno.json)

render_hints.skin_base: middleage_caucasian_male (#dab396) tinted toward tone_hex_recommended #dd9975 (the swatch is about the same lightness, so the tint mostly warms it). Texture picked by age and swatch colour only.

ethnicity_fit.basis: Fitted by eye to how MakeHuman's three shape bases reproduce what the photos show: almond eyes with a slight inner-corner fold and a moderately low lid crease, high broad cheekbones, a straight medium-height bridge and a rounded, medium-wide nose tip. Not assigned from name or nationality.
ethnicity_fit.confidence: low: his features sit between the bases; check a render against the ESPN headshot and drop or flatten the block if the eyes come out too hooded

morphs_if_available.note: Ear targets from the full MakeHuman set; not in the shipped manifest.

morphs_unavailable: Cauliflower ear cannot be made with a MakeHuman target: sculpt or normal-map both ears (right a little worse). No target for the skin fade, crow's feet or smile folds (use the middle-age skin texture or a normal map).
notes: Confidence: high for hair, clean-shaven face, ears, tattoos and build; medium-high for face proportions (studio frontal, two right profiles and a three-quarter); medium for morph values; low for guard. Watch for: (1) recognition cues are the high cheekbones with hollow cheeks, the low straight dark brows, slightly narrow almond eyes with crow's feet, the rounded nose tip and the cauliflower ears; (2) he is clean-shaven now; do not give him the 2021 moustache; (3) tattoo sides: colour serpent on the LEFT chest, black-and-grey on the RIGHT shoulder, upper arm and forearm, sword on the LEFT forearm; (4) lean but softer-edged than Taira or Van, with longer legs than Van; (5) macro/heightDownM 0.19 comes from heightUpM = 2 * (H - 1.785 m) / 0.875 (research/assets.md); some other 170 cm sheets use 0.27, so measure the mesh and nudge it to 170 cm. ageOldM 0.122 follows avatar3d.js (32.9 - 25) / 65. The ethnicity_fit block is opt-in for avatar3d.js; drop it if the orchestrator wants the neutral thirds kept.
